summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by BTQ Technologies Corp., a foreign private issuer, announcing a strategic collaboration with TIDAL PWR to develop a trusted quantum data center architecture. The filing describes a non-binding collaboration to create design principles, procurement standards, and deployment models for quantum-enabled data centers. No specific deal terms, stake, price, premium, or transaction structure are mentioned. The collaboration does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special situation category. As a routine business update regarding a strategic partnership, it does not qualify as a special situation event under the defined categories.
